command.description: Path to the executable program to run as a daemon (required)

args.description: List of arguments to pass to the command

chdir.description: Working directory for the daemon (default: root directory)

stdout.description: Path to redirect standard output (must be on same filesystem as chdir)

stderr.description: Path to redirect standard error (must be on same filesystem as chdir)

append_output.description: Append to output files instead of overwriting (only effective with stdout/stderr set)

pidfile.description: Path to write the daemon's PID (empty string means disabled)

lockfile.description: Path to lockfile for single-instance enforcement (empty string means disabled)

user.description: User to run the daemon as (requires root privileges)

env.description: List of environment variables in NAME=value format (e.g., ['PATH=/usr/bin', 'FOO=bar'])

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging of daemonize's actions to stderr
